edits.new:
Then the outbox holds the run facts and the proposal as CloudEvents 1.0 messages on "rwb.agent.events.v1", keyed by the case ID, in the same transaction, and no field classed as personal data is carried

  Scenario: AC16 A replayed write with the same key is stored once (story criterion for BR6)
    Given EV-16 for document "D-1001" on case "RW-2026-000401" has written its run with key "SCREENING:<caseId>:<eventId>"
    When the same write arrives again with the same key
    Then one run exists for that key and the repeat is not stored a second time

  Scenario: AC17 A status change the model does not allow is refused (story criterion for the run state)
    Given a run holds status "TIMED_OUT" for case "RW-2026-000404"
    When a status change that the run state model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused, the run keeps status "TIMED_OUT" and it is not retried for that event
